abstract: SDD workflow for ASOME projects, implemented with OpenSpec. Defines when SDD is required (by issue kind and story points), the change-name convention, the six /opsx:* commands and what each writes, the board stage to phase map, and the split between OpenSpec as artifact store and engram as persistent memory. Replaces the previous memory-backed flow: artifacts are versioned Markdown that travel in the same PR as the code, so a reviewer sees the contract and the implementation together.
